versions.content: If the SW-C or BSW module cannot not provide the requested data (ReadDataElement returns other than E_OK), the Dem shall fill the missing data with the padding value 0xFF, report the runtime error DEM_E_NODATAAVAILABLE to the Det and continue its normal operation.
